title: RLC 并联电路与复导纳
statement: R = 10 Ω、L = 5 mH、C = 100 µF 并联后接在 V̇_s = 100∠0° V（有效值）上，ω = 1000 rad/s。电流表 A 测总电流 I（参考方向见图）。
求电感电流 I_L，以及总电流 I 的有效值和相位。再求并联部分的复导纳 Y。

questions.explain: X_L = ωL = 5 Ω，I_L = V/X_L = 100/5 = 20 A，相位滞后电压 90°。

questions.ask: 总电流有效值 I（电流表读数）= ?
总电流 I 的相位 = ?
并联部分的复导纳 Y 和电路性质是？
choiceExplain: 电纳的符号弄反了：电容的导纳是 +jωC = +j0.1 S，电感是 −j/(ωL) = −j0.2 S，算成 j(0.2 − 0.1) 就得到这个错误结果。
把电容的导纳也写成负的（−jωC），两个电纳相加得到 −j0.3 S；实际上 L、C 的电纳符号相反，要相减。

hints: 并联时各支路电压相同，先分别求 I_R、I_L、I_C。
相量形式的 KCL：İ = İ_R + İ_L + İ_C，注意 İ_L 滞后 90°、İ_C 超前 90°，不能把有效值直接相加。
复导纳 Y = G + j(B_C − B_L)，İ = Y·V̇。

en.title: Parallel RLC and complex admittance
statement: R = 10 Ω, L = 5 mH and C = 100 µF in parallel are connected to V̇_s = 100∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s. The ammeter A measures the total current I (reference direction as drawn).
Find the inductor current I_L, and the rms value and phase of the total current I. Then find the complex admittance Y of the parallel combination.

questions.explain: X_L = ωL = 5 Ω, I_L = V/X_L = 100/5 = 20 A, lagging the voltage by 90°.

questions.ask: Phase of the total current I = ?
questions.explain: İ = 10 − j10 = 14.14∠−45° A, lagging the voltage by 45°.

questions.ask: What is the complex admittance Y of the parallel part, and what kind of load is it?
choiceExplain: The susceptance signs are swapped: the capacitor's admittance is +jωC = +j0.1 S and the inductor's −j/(ωL) = −j0.2 S; computing j(0.2 − 0.1) gives this wrong result.
This writes the capacitor's admittance as negative (−jωC) too, so the susceptances add to −j0.3 S; in fact L and C have opposite signs and partly cancel.
questions.explain: Y = G + j(B_C − B_L) = 1/10 + j(ωC − 1/(ωL)) = 0.1 + j(0.1 − 0.2) = 0.1 − j0.1 S. The imaginary part is negative (B_L > B_C), the current lags the voltage, so the load is inductive. Check: İ = Y·V̇ = (0.1 − j0.1) × 100 = 10 − j10 A.

hints: In parallel every branch has the same voltage; find I_R, I_L and I_C first.
Phasor KCL: İ = İ_R + İ_L + İ_C. İ_L lags by 90° and İ_C leads by 90°, so rms values cannot simply be added.
Complex admittance Y = G + j(B_C − B_L), and İ = Y·V̇.
solution: **2. Phasor KCL.** İ = İ_R + İ_L + İ_C = 10 − j20 + j10 = 10 − j10 A = **14.14∠−45° A**. (Adding rms values would give 40 A, which is wrong.)
Check: İ = Y·V̇ = (0.1 − j0.1) × 100 = 10 − j10 A ✓. B_L > B_C, so the load is **inductive** and the current lags the voltage by 45°.
